correctness.rationale: Exact cluster index monotonicity follows from forth and mutual accessibility. Back at the final source cluster in every target segment forces its restriction onto the whole target cluster; the converse gives full successor-image equality pointwise. Inclusion-exclusion counts the labeled choices. Source and target symmetric groups act separately within each fixed ordered cluster; their orbits are exactly multisets of positive-terminal-coordinate fiber vectors, establishing the coefficient extraction. Verified 395 exhaustive composition-pairs, 1,550 bounded morphisms and 247 profile orbits; an independent explicit group-action checker passed 22 cases. Limits are finite and unvalued.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The logical difference is not superficial notation: the S4.3 forth condition forces monotone target-level assignment, and back forces a surjection specifically from the final source cluster of every target segment, while earlier source clusters may map non-surjectively. Neither ordinary monotonicity on antichains nor independent S5-block surjections implies this joint condition. Orbit columns also couple several ordered source clusters.

value.rationale: Complete all-parameter classification and exact automorphism-orbit enumeration of onto modal quotients between natural S4.3 finite linear-preorder frames. Gives sharp nonexistence based on ordered subsequences of source cluster capacities, extends the partition-count case of matched heights, and captures coupled fiber-profile invariants not obtainable by raw cardinality or mere ordered-level counting. Modal validity is preserved by these quotients; this is structural classification of natural mathematical objects, not a tiny finite gain.
